purpose: Isolate the contribution of source-probability mass in exact Gibbs permutation transport on the frozen Tartan target-domain checkpoints.

arms.ascent_native: Target-airport ASCENT support and native probabilities.
arms.target_native: Shared target support and its native decision-logit probabilities.
arms.target_energy: Shared target support and the target model's Energy-optimal probabilities without a transported prior.
arms.uniform_energy_kl: Shared target support with a uniform prior followed by the frozen Energy-KL projection.
arms.sinkhorn_energy_kl: Shared target support with a fixed-iteration Sinkhorn prior followed by the frozen Energy-KL projection.
arms.gibbs_unweighted_prior: Shared target support with exact Gibbs permutation transport whose assignment cost uses uniform source weights.
arms.gibbs_mass_aware_prior: Shared target support with exact Gibbs permutation transport whose assignment cost uses predicted source mass.
arms.gibbs_unweighted_energy_kl: Unweighted exact Gibbs prior followed by the frozen Energy-KL projection.
arms.gibbs_mass_aware_energy_kl: Mass-aware exact Gibbs prior followed by the frozen Energy-KL projection; the pre-amendment MABPT probability operator.
arms.source_target_native_union10: Uncompressed ten-atom union of ASCENT-native and target-native measures with equal model mass; a different-support cardinality control, not a component attribution arm.

shared_support_primary_comparison.only_changed_factor: Whether predicted source probability mass weights the permutation assignment cost.
shared_support_primary_comparison.pooled_estimand: Equal-weight mean over the four airport-by-regime cells; seeds are paired globally and calendar dates are resampled within seed and cell with actor weighting.

development_decision_rule.retain_mass_aware_name: The pooled 95% bootstrap CI for unweighted-minus-mass-aware Energy is above zero and the point gain is at least 0.001.
development_decision_rule.otherwise: Freeze gibbs_unweighted_energy_kl as the parsimonious operator and recommend Exact Gibbs Permutation Transport rather than Mass-Aware as the leading name.
development_decision_rule.test_role: Report every frozen arm after the development receipt is created; never revise the selected operator from test results.

claim_boundaries: The component analysis is prospective relative to its development-only selection receipt, but the retrospective test cohort was used previously for the main ASCENT-versus-MABPT analysis and is not a fresh blind holdout.
A shared-support probability operator cannot change minADE or minFDE; those metrics are reported once as geometry checks, not as evidence for mass-aware transport.
The union-10 control has a different support and cardinality and is reported separately from probability attribution.
Failure to satisfy the registered development rule means that an independent mass-aware contribution is not established.
